Orienting pairs with c>b yields the exact four-parameter generating product and the cubic asymptotics; no finite experiment is used as an infinite proof. Exhaustive direct triple-subsequence verification at lengths 3 through 16 agrees with all class-size and count claims. Boundary n=3..6 produces no collision as required.

value.rationale: The three-deck channel is an established model of exact subsequence readout. The weight-three stratum is the first constant-weight layer with genuine ambiguity (first at n=7), and its complete equivalence-class classification yields the precise zero-error constant-weight codebook size at every length and a 7/8 limiting efficiency. This supplies a structural and enumerative answer for a natural channel subproblem, not a random finite cutoff or mere renaming of known deck totals.
